tools.name: get_datis
tools.description: Return the latest D-ATIS letter and text for one airport. Use for a single ICAO. Use get_airport_conditions when you also need METAR or an existing ATIS or AWOS transcript. Use get_datis_all for every current D-ATIS.

tools.name: get_datis_all
tools.description: Return every current D-ATIS in one payload. Requires a paid plan. Use get_datis for one airport. Use get_airport_conditions for METAR plus a recent transcript.

tools.name: get_airport_conditions
tools.description: Return latest conditions for one airport: ATIS or transcript, METAR, TAF summary, ATIS phone, and basic airport id and name. This tool never starts a phone-line dial. Pass include_airport true for the full airport record. Use get_datis for D-ATIS only, get_metar for METAR only, and get_notams for st

tools.name: list_atis_airports
tools.description: List airports with D-ATIS and transcribed ATIS or AWOS coverage. Use search_airports to look up any airport by ident, name, or location.

tools.name: get_notams
tools.description: Return stored NOTAMs for one airport or one NOTAM number. Requires a paid plan. Pass icao or number. Use get_airport_conditions with include=notams when you already need airport weather in the same call.

tools.name: get_advisories
tools.description: Return active SIGMET, AIRMET, and G-AIRMET records. Use for inflight weather hazards. Use get_traffic_advisories for ATCSCC NAS traffic notes, not weather. Optional kind, bbox, or lat and lon with radius_nm.

tools.name: get_pireps
tools.description: Return stored PIREPs near a point or airport. Pass lat and lon, or icao. Use get_advisories for SIGMET and AIRMET, not pilot reports. Optional airport, radius_nm, and hours.

tools.name: get_metar
tools.description: Return the latest METAR for one ICAO, or several ids in one call. Use for observation-only weather. Use get_taf for forecasts. Use get_airport_conditions when you also need D-ATIS or a recent transcript. Pass icao or ids, not both.

tools.name: get_taf
tools.description: Return the latest TAF for one airport. Use for forecast weather. Use get_metar for the current observation.

tools.name: get_airport
tools.description: Return structured airport data for one airport. Provide icao or faa_loc_id. Use get_airport_conditions for weather and transcripts. Use get_runways, get_frequencies, or get_airport_remarks for a single nested table.

tools.name: search_airports
tools.description: Search airports by ident, name, city and state, or nearby lat and lon. Use get_airport when you already have an ident. Use list_atis_airports for coverage only.

tools.name: get_runways
tools.description: Return runway data for one airport. Provide icao or faa_loc_id. Use get_airport for the full airport record.

tools.name: get_frequencies
tools.description: Return airport frequencies. Provide icao or faa_loc_id. Use get_airport for the full airport record.

tools.name: get_airport_remarks
tools.description: Return FAA airport remarks. Provide icao or faa_loc_id. Use get_airport for the full airport record.

tools.name: get_chart_supplement
tools.description: Return Chart Supplement text for one airport. Provide icao or faa_loc_id. Use get_airport for structured fields.

tools.name: get_awos
tools.description: Return the AWOS and ASOS station catalog. Optional icao, faa_loc_id, station, or lat and lon with radius_nm. This is station metadata, not a METAR. Use get_metar for the observation.

tools.name: get_aircraft
tools.description: Look up one FAA registered aircraft. Provide n_number or icao_hex. Registry fields only, no live position. Use get_traffic_flight for live state.

tools.name: get_aircraft_types
tools.description: Return FAA aircraft type reference. Provide code, or search with mfr and optional model. Use get_aircraft for a tail number.

tools.name: get_schedule_flight
tools.description: Return published and observed schedules for an airline flight. Pass ident such as UAL28 or UA28. Optional date. Use get_traffic_flight for live position. Use get_traffic_arrivals or get_traffic_departures for a live airport board.

tools.name: get_schedule_route
tools.description: Return published schedules between two airports. Requires departure and arrival. Optional date. Use get_traffic_flights for live aircraft on a route area.

tools.name: get_schedule_airport
tools.description: Return published arrivals and departures at an airport. Optional date. Use get_traffic_arrivals or get_traffic_departures for the live board.

tools.name: get_traffic_flights
tools.description: Return live flights near a point or airport, inside a bounding box, or matching an operator and flight number. Nearby and box results default to airborne flights. Pass include_ground true to include completed, dropped, and on-ground statuses. Use one form per request. Use get_traffic_flight for one

tools.name: get_traffic_flight
tools.description: Return the latest live flight state for one aircraft, including a delay object with a plain-language explanation, decoded route_points, the flown trail when present, and predicted_arrival with a short basis code. Pass exactly one of ident or gufi. Use get_traffic_flights for nearby traffic. Use get_

tools.name: get_traffic_arrivals
tools.description: Return current flights arriving at an airport. Use get_traffic_departures for outbound flights. Use get_schedule_airport for published times.

tools.name: get_traffic_departures
tools.description: Return current flights departing an airport. Use get_traffic_arrivals for inbound flights. Use get_schedule_airport for published times.

tools.name: get_traffic_ground_stops
tools.description: Return active FAA ground stops across the NAS. Use get_traffic_delays for the stops, GDPs, restrictions, and configuration at one airport. Use get_traffic_ground_delay_programs for GDPs only.

tools.name: get_traffic_ground_delay_programs
tools.description: Return active ground delay programs across the NAS. Use get_traffic_delays for one airport summary. Use get_traffic_ground_stops for ground stops only.

tools.name: get_traffic_restrictions
tools.description: Return active NAS flow restrictions. Use get_traffic_delays for restrictions, stops, and GDPs at one airport.

tools.name: get_traffic_advisories
tools.description: Return recent ATCSCC advisories about NAS traffic. Use get_advisories for SIGMET, AIRMET, and G-AIRMET weather. Use get_traffic_delays for the delay package at one airport.

tools.name: get_traffic_delays
tools.description: Return ground stops, ground delay programs, restrictions, advisories, and airport configuration for one airport. Requires airport. Use get_traffic_ground_stops, get_traffic_ground_delay_programs, get_traffic_restrictions, or get_traffic_advisories for NAS-wide lists.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_aircraft_types" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
